diff --git a/packaging/jsoncpp.spec b/packaging/jsoncpp.spec
index d38b4ee..7adf46e 100644
--- a/packaging/jsoncpp.spec
+++ b/packaging/jsoncpp.spec
@@ -1,5 +1,11 @@
 %global jsondir json
 
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 Name:       jsoncpp
 Version:    1.9.6
 Release:    0
@@ -12,6 +18,10 @@ Source1:    baselibs.conf
 Source1001: jsoncpp.manifest
 
 BuildRequires:  cmake
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
+BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 %{name} is an implementation of a JSON (http://json.org) reader and writer in
@@ -33,16 +43,18 @@ This package contains the development headers and library for %{name}.
 cp %{SOURCE1001} .
 
 %build
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 mkdir build
-pushd build
+(cd build && \
 %cmake -DJSONCPP_WITH_TESTS=OFF \
        -DJSONCPP_WITH_POST_BUILD_UNITTEST=OFF \
        -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
        -DBUILD_STATIC_LIBS=OFF \
-       ..
-
-%__make %{?_smp_mflags}
-popd
+       .. && \
+%__make %{?_smp_mflags})
 
 # Build the doc
 # python doxybuild.py --doxygen %{_bindir}/doxygen
@@ -52,9 +64,8 @@ popd
 # ctest -V %{?_smp_mflags}
 
 %install
-pushd build
-%__make install DESTDIR=%{buildroot}
-popd
+(cd build && \
+%__make install DESTDIR=%{buildroot})
 
 #mkdir -p $RPM_BUILD_ROOT%{_docdir}/%{name}/html
 #for f in AUTHORS LICENSE NEWS.txt README.md ; do
@@ -87,4 +98,3 @@ rm -rf $RPM_BUILD_ROOT%{_libdir}/objects-Release
 %{_includedir}/%{jsondir}
 %{_includedir}/%{name}/%{jsondir}/*.h
 %{_libdir}/pkgconfig/jsoncpp.pc
